current_goal: Develop the performable FUSU album/live version through sustained atmosphere, expressive piano/electronics and low-frequency weight. Revise one passage at a time; four candidates/two systems are first-round work ceilings, never completion quotas or a final track count. No required new direction.
first_action: Preserve the active Mac FUSU source and owners; collect current source/media and link the three screenshot-reported Renew studies to actual versions. Prioritize one piano dry/electronic comparison with complete phrasing. Use existing suitable material if present; do not regenerate a batch, substitute AMB or restart rejected audio.
priority: M0/R0 source and audition first; reuse an existing candidate rather than duplicating it.
M3: expressive piano with electronics is an explicit audition requirement. Preserve touch, voicing, phrasing and natural releases; distinguish recorded performance from programmed MIDI.

M0 or M1: test low-frequency weight and sustained time using sparse material; M2 fills an actual texture/space gap only. Four candidates/two deepened systems are ceilings. Work on one revision at a time; no mandatory new direction.

Prove one continuous dimension and intervention/release; add NEXT only for selected systems. Free-time passages use musical cues, not forced bar boundaries. Record two audibly different takes from the same material.

Windows preserves its existing independent Renew studies and visual work, consumes immutable Mac packages, and prioritizes V1. V2/V3 remain conditional on musical need. Prove performer-led timing with accepted material, even one source initially; develop the full proposed slot only after real acceptance.
